items.originalTitle: Five quick takeaways from US GP
detailZh: 基米·安东内利又赢了一场——现在他几乎可以确定在墨西哥夺冠了。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利
基米·安东内利在德克萨斯州夺冠的可能性从来不大——需要太多事情同时发生。但他尽力了，完美地度过了一个周末。这是他自夏天斯帕以来第一次获得杆位，随后又以干净的比赛和两种轮胎配方上的强劲速度赢得了胜利。在这个充满精彩表现的赛季中，他又一次展现了大师级的表现。
他在奥斯汀并不急需获胜。冠军实际上已经属于他很长时间了，现在只是个形式。除非发生一些非常规的事情，否则安东内利现在不可能失去冠军。
他无可置疑地出色——现在他很可能在墨西哥正式结束冠军争夺战，这将是他的第一个冠军，也是他未来许多冠军中的第一个，创造历史。
梅赛德斯不得不耐心等待，但它似乎最终在马来西亚巴林大奖赛推出的升级套件中释放了潜力……至少在车库里的一侧。
布拉克利车队为雪邦带来了全面的套件，使W17本身更快，但给车手们留下了更窄的设置窗口。对赛车行为不满意，拉塞尔在新加坡回归到之前的规格，为梅赛德斯提供了两个套件之间的直接比较。
安东内利和拉塞尔在奥斯汀进行了升级测试，这与他们在新加坡进行的测试以及本周末的比赛有关。
安东内利驾驶着W17赛车，提出了一个不同的方案。这位意大利人在周六的比赛中获得了他八年来在大奖赛中的第一个杆位，从周日灯光熄灭的那一刻起，他就朝着胜利的方向前进。
拉塞尔现在必须开始担心2027年了。
虽然乔治·拉塞尔在数学上仍然有机会争夺今年的冠军，但实际上这毫无意义——只要拉塞尔不赢得比赛，基米·安东内利下周日就能锁定冠军。所以，可能是时候让乔治专注于为2027年找到正确的答案了。
在此之前，他的职业生涯几乎是完美的，赢得了所有最重要的青训系列赛，并在与像刘易斯·汉密尔顿这样难以对付的对手同在一辆赛车中证明了自己的实力。看起来他唯一缺少的就是一辆赛车。但就在他终于得到它的时候，一个不可阻挡的力量，一个年轻的卷发意大利人，破坏了一切。
拉塞尔现在需要做出反应——并且尽可能地彻底为下一年做准备。无论是他的驾驶技术还是其他因素阻止了他与安东内利的速度相匹配，他都需要利用2026年剩余的赛事找到尽可能多的答案，或者甚至尝试不同的方法。
因为像奥斯汀这样的周末就展示了梅赛德斯车队队友之间性能差距的巨大。拉塞尔在状态好的时候可以击败基米，但这样的低谷，他未来将无法持续地挑战他。
作为别人的副手度过职业生涯肯定不是拉塞尔梦寐以求的——但这样的周末之后，这个前景看起来越来越现实。
劳森在舞台和赛道上都击中了正确的音符。
劳森在周四晚上的奥斯汀舞台上表现出色，尽管他承认在‘世界音乐之都’表演比在一级方程式大奖赛上比赛带来了‘十倍的压力’。
他以从容的态度接受了这一点，并在驾驶座上又展现了一次自信的表现——这在2026年已经变得司空见惯。
小红牛车队的车手在周五以第六快的成绩起步，然后在周六进行了团队游戏，在Q3期间留在维修区，以帮助队友Arvid Lindblad避免在五罚位的基础上再失去一个发车位。
周日，劳森如预期地带领车队的中游车手完成了比赛。第九名是所有八辆来自前四支车队的车辆所能达到的最佳成绩，但他的本赛季第13个积分帮助小红牛车队进一步拉大了与阿尔派的差距，而阿尔派车队在 constructors' championship 中获得第五的希望正在逐渐消失。
越来越难以相信这个人明年还没有合同。
威廉姆斯车队在2025年一直强调其重点是2026年，但仍然设法获得了两个领奖台。然而，在2026年，车队一次又一次地令人失望。解释是，它将所有的鸡蛋都放在了一个篮子里，一个重大升级包计划在巴库到来。威廉姆斯在阿塞拜疆获得了积分——这是它在过去12场比赛中仅能实现一次的事情——但升级最终证明不如预期有效。
奥斯汀可能已经达到了新低，威廉姆斯车队在排位赛中仅领先凯迪拉克，甚至在拉恩斯·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁之后。车队一直是Q1退出的明显候选人，正如最终证明的那样，而在比赛中，它被困在无人地带，甚至远离中游的战斗。
赛季剩余部分——无论是五场比赛、四场还是剩下的任何数量——对威廉姆斯来说看起来都将是一个漫长的赛季，车队再次承诺2027年将更好。
detailEn: Another win for Kimi Antonelli – with the Italian now almost certain to clinch the title in Mexico.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari

Kimi Antonelli was never likely to clinch the title in Texas – too many things needed to fall into place. But he did everything he could, delivering a perfect weekend. His first pole since Spa in the middle of the summer, followed by a commanding victory – with a clean start and strong pace on both tyre compounds. Another masterclass in a season full of them.

He didn't desperately need to win in Austin. The title has effectively been his for a long time, and now it's just a formality. Something extraordinary would need to happen for Antonelli to lose the title now.
He's exceptional, there's no doubt left – and it's now more than likely he'll officially wrap up the championship, his first of surely many more to come, in Mexico. History in the making.
Mercedes has had to be patient, but it finally appears to have unlocked the potential of the upgrade package it introduced at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia… at least on one side of the garage.

The Brackley squad brought a comprehensive package to Sepang that made the W17 intrinsically quicker, but left its drivers with a narrower set-up window. Unhappy with the car's behaviour, Russell reverted to the previous specification in Singapore, giving Mercedes a direct comparison between the two packages.
Both Antonelli and Russell ran the upgrades in Austin, along with a front wing Mercedes had already trialled in Singapore with this weekend in mind.

With Antonelli at the wheel, the W17 was a different proposition. The Italian secured his first pole position in eight grands prix on Saturday and was on course for victory from the moment the lights went out on Sunday.
Russell must start worrying about 2027 now

While George Russell is still mathematically in contention for this year's title, it effectively means nothing – Kimi Antonelli will clinch the championship next Sunday as long as Russell doesn't win the race. So it's probably time for George to focus on finding the right answers for 2027.

Until this season, he'd had a near-perfect career, winning all the most important junior series before proving himself against as tough an opponent as you can get – Lewis Hamilton in the same garage. It looked like the only thing he lacked was the car. But just when he finally got it, an unstoppable force in the form of a young, curly-haired Italian spoiled everything.

Russell needs to react now – and prepare for next year as thoroughly as possible. Whether it's his driving or something else that's preventing him from matching Antonelli's pace, he needs to use the remaining races of 2026 to find as many answers as possible, or perhaps even experiment with different approaches.

Because weekends like Austin show just how staggering the performance gap between the Mercedes team-mates can be. Russell can beat Kimi on a good day, but with lows this deep, he won't be able to challenge him consistently in the future.
A career spent as someone's wingman is surely not what Russell dreamed of – but that prospect looks increasingly realistic after weekends like this.
Lawson hits the right notes on stage and on track

Lawson acquitted himself well on stage in Austin on Thursday night, despite admitting that performing in the Live Music Capital of the World brought "ten times more pressure" than racing in a Formula 1 grand prix.
Having taken that in his stride, he delivered another assured performance behind the wheel — something that has become a familiar sight in 2026.

The Racing Bulls driver started strongly with the sixth-fastest time on Friday, then played the team game on Saturday, staying in the garage during Q3 to spare team-mate Arvid Lindblad a further grid position on top of his five-place penalty.

On Sunday, Lawson duly led the midfield home. Ninth was the best available with all eight cars from the leading four teams reaching the finish, but his 13th points finish of the season helped Racing Bulls pull further clear of Alpine, whose hopes of claiming fifth in the constructors' championship are fading.
It's increasingly hard to believe this guy still doesn't have a contract for next year.

Williams spent 2025 insisting that its focus was entirely on 2026, yet still managed to score two podiums. In 2026, however, the team has disappointed time and again. The explanation was that it was putting all its eggs in one basket with a major upgrade package scheduled to arrive in Baku. Williams scored points in Azerbaijan – something it has only managed once in its last 12 races – but the upgrade ultimately proved less effective than hoped.

Austin may have marked a new low, with Williams finishing ahead of only Cadillac and even trailing Lance Stroll's Aston Martin. The team was always a clear candidate for a Q1 exit in qualifying, as ultimately proved to be the case, while in the race it was stranded in no man's land, well off even the midfield battle.
The remainder of the season – whether five races, four or however many are left – looks set to be a long one for Williams, which is once again promising that 2027 will be better.

items.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Kimi Antonelli takes dominant victory - but no title
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：基米·安东内利夺得冠军，但无冠军头衔
基米·安东内利在2026年F1赛季美国大奖赛中夺得第九胜，将首个世界冠军头衔的争夺推向了高潮
基米·安东内利通过在美国大奖赛中的统治性胜利，又向不可避免的F1世界冠军迈进了一步，他在奥斯汀的美国赛车场击败了查尔斯·勒克莱尔
从杆位发车，这位梅赛德斯车手抵御了来自法拉利车手和马克斯·维斯塔潘的挑战，他坚持了银箭的完美计划，完成了一场干净的单停站比赛。
安东内利的2026年第9场大奖赛胜利还不够确保冠军，但这位20岁的意大利人现在看起来将在下周墨西哥大奖赛中成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
安东内利在56圈比赛的开始阶段保持了领先，而排在第二位的维斯塔潘起步不佳。这使红牛车手对勒克莱尔变得脆弱，勒克莱尔在艾塞斯弯道以高投入的动作超越了哈迪亚尔，随后又超越了维斯塔潘。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿从使用过的软胎起步，也设法超越了哈迪亚尔。在他身后，乔治·罗素在第一圈防守位置时驶离赛道，被处以5秒时间罚分。随着排名前列的局势稳定下来，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第八圈被告知让速度更快的兰多·诺里斯超过，以获得第七名。
在前面，安东内利以狭窄但稳固的3秒领先维斯塔潘。这促使红牛冒险，在第14圈叫荷兰人进站更换第二套软胎，使他进行两停的比赛。
梅赛德斯没有上钩，继续让安东内利留在赛道上，看起来他们决心坚持一停策略。汉密尔顿在用过的软胎上抓地力不足，接下来进站换上了中性胎，他的队友勒克莱尔和两辆麦克拉伦车队也是如此。
这暂时让安东内利、哈迪尔和拉塞尔占据了前三的位置，直到所有人都进站进行原本认为是他们唯一的停站，安东内利完全放弃了软胎，从中性胎直接换上了硬胎，在第25圈完成这一操作。
维斯塔潘并没有享受他新获得的领先太久，因为他开始遇到发动机制动问题，称他的红牛赛车“无法驾驶”。这迫使他第32圈进站进行第二次停站，换上中性胎，排名下降到第五，落后新的领跑者安东内利18秒。
在较慢的硬胎上，安东内利面临勒克莱尔的挑战，但他和法拉利车队的队友汉密尔顿都还没有再次停站，因为维斯塔潘仍然是安东内利的真正挑战者。两辆法拉利赛车在最后三分之一的时间段换上了硬胎，这使得它们落后于维斯塔潘。
为了到达安东内利的赛道，维斯塔潘首先必须超越排名第二的诺里斯，后者也押注了一站式策略。维斯塔潘与诺里斯的较量让勒克莱尔得以利用更新的轮胎缩小差距，三辆车在比赛还剩10圈时并驾齐驱。
在第47圈开始时，维斯塔潘在COTA的陡峭的1号弯内侧对诺里斯发动了猛烈的进攻，在勒克莱尔也找到突破机会之前，抢占了第二的位置。在更新的轮胎上，勒克莱尔在第49圈的后直道上超越了维斯塔潘，夺得了第二的位置。
安东内利的胜利从未真正受到威胁，他领先勒克莱尔13秒，维斯塔潘以4秒之差排在第三。
诺里斯也陷入了汉密尔顿的掌握之中，后者在第51圈从世界冠军手中夺得了第四名，这也意味着这位七届世界冠军在下周之前仍然保有数学上的冠军争夺权。
哈达尔在皮亚斯特里之前完成第六名，皮亚斯特里在第七名中领先了拉塞尔。由于拉塞尔需要避免以第九名或更低的成绩结束，以延长他理论上的冠军机会，他在一个令人沮丧的周末后勉强做到了这一点。
利亚姆·劳森继续帮助小红牛车队在车队积分榜上前进至第五名，他以第九名的成绩完成了比赛，最后一名积分被阿尔皮纳的皮埃尔·加斯利获得。安东内利现在几乎可以确定将在墨西哥夺冠，他只需要两分就能成为有史以来最年轻的20岁冠军。
哈斯车手奥利弗·贝尔曼是三名退赛者之一，这是由于他在第一圈与加斯利的接触造成的第一次碰撞，英国人因此被罚10秒，并引发了一段短暂的虚拟安全车(VSC)阶段。
阿尔皮纳的弗朗科·科拉平托也退出了比赛，而凯迪拉克的瓦尔特里·博塔斯在比赛后期因发动机故障退赛，引发了比赛的第二次短暂的虚拟安全车(VSC)阶段。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Kimi Antonelli takes dominant victory - but no title
Kimi Antonelli has moved to the brink of a maiden world title after taking his ninth win of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the United States Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli has taken another step towards an inevitable Formula 1 title with a sovereign United States Grand Prix win, defeating Charles Leclerc at Austin's Circuit of the Americas.
From pole, the Mercedes driver warded off a challenge from the Ferrari man and Max Verstappen as he stuck to the Silver Arrows’ masterplan and executed a clean one-stop race.

Antonelli's ninth grand prix win of 2026 wasn't quite enough to secure the title just yet, but the 20-year-old Italian now looks set to become F1's youngest ever world champion at next weekend's Mexico Grand Prix.

Antonelli held onto his lead at the start of the 56-lap race as second-placed Verstappen suffered a poor getaway. That left the Red Bull driver vulnerable to Leclerc, who had picked off Isack Hadjar and then swept past Verstappen with a high commitment move through the Esses.

Lewis Hamilton, starting on used softs, also worked his way past Hadjar. Behind him, George Russell was handed a five-second time penalty for going off the track on lap one while defending his position. As the top of the order settled down, Oscar Piastri was told to let quicker Lando Norris past on lap eight for seventh.

At the front, Antonelli controlled a narrow but sovereign three-second lead on Verstappen. That prompted Red Bull to roll the dice and call the Dutchman in on lap 14 for a second set of soft tyres, putting him on a two-stop race.

Mercedes didn't take the bait and kept Antonelli out as it looked determined to stay on a one-stop strategy. Struggling for grip on used softs, Hamilton came in for mediums next, as did his team-mate Leclerc and the two McLarens.

That left a temporary top three of Antonelli, Hadjar and Russell until all came in for what was supposed to be their only pitstop, with Antonelli eschewing the soft tyres entirely to go from mediums to hards on lap 25.

Verstappen didn't enjoy his new-found lead all that long as he started struggling with engine braking issues, calling his Red Bull "undriveable". It forced him into the pits on lap 32 for a second stop for mediums, dropping down to fifth, 18 seconds behind new leader Antonelli.

On the slower hard tyres Antonelli faced a challenge from Leclerc, but both he and Ferrari team-mate Hamilton were yet to stop again as Verstappen remained Antonelli's real challenger. The two Ferraris both moved to hard tyres in the final third, which droppèd them behind Verstappen.

To get to Antonelli, though, Verstappen first had to clear second-placed Norris, who also banked on a one-stop strategy. Verstappen's battle with Norris allowed Leclerc to exploit his fresher tyres and close the gap, with the three cars converging with 10 laps to go.

At the start of lap 47, Verstappen made a late lunge on Norris to the inside of COTA's steep Turn 1 hairpin, snatching second away before Leclerc also found a way through. On much fresher tyres, Leclerc then picked off Verstappen on the back straight on lap 49 to take second.
Antonelli's win never came under real threat as he led Leclerc by 13 seconds, with Verstappen another four seconds behind in third.

Norris also fell into the clutches of Hamilton as the latter secured fourth from the reigning world champion on lap 51, which also meant the seven-time world champion remained in mathematical title contention until next week.

Hadjar finished sixth ahead of Piastri, who held off Russell for a distant seventh. With Russell needing to avoid finishing ninth or lower to prolong his theoretical title chances, he only just managed to do so after a frustrating weekend.

Liam Lawson continued Racing Bulls' canter to fifth in the constructors' championship by finishing ninth, with the final point going to Alpine's Pierre Gasly. Antonelli is now all but certain to wrap up the championship in Mexico, needing just two points to become the youngest ever title winner aged 20.

Haas driver Oliver Bearman was one of three retirements, the eventual result of first-lap damage from contact with Gasly, which the Briton was handed a 10-second penalty for and provoked a brief VSC period.
Alpine's Franco Colapinto also disappeared from the race, while Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas retired late on with engine trouble, causing the second brief virtual safety car period of the race.

items.summaryZh: 虽然未能锁定车手冠军，但基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛中统治全场，向他的首个F1世界冠军迈进了一大步。
items.originalTitle: F1 2026 United States Grand Prix race result
detailZh: 尽管他未能锁定车手冠军，但基米·安东内利在的美国大奖赛中统治了比赛，向他的首个一级方程式赛车冠军迈出了巨大的一步。
以下是比赛的赛果。
16 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+1圈
detailEn: It wasn't the perfect result as he wasn't able to seal the drivers' title, but Kimi Antonelli dominated the United States Grand Prix to take a massive leap towards his first Formula 1 title.
Here are the results from the race.
16 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1 lap
keyPointsZh: 基米·安东内利在F1 2026美国大奖赛中夺冠
查尔斯·勒克莱尔获得第二名，差距为13.078秒
马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第三名，差距为17.485秒
keyPointsEn: Kimi Antonelli won the F1 2026 United States Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc finished second, 13.078 seconds behind
Max Verstappen finished third, 17.485 seconds behind
